name: 01949 · Middleton, MA
findings: ZIP 01949 (Middleton) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01949 (Middleton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
